title: HALLOWEEN SPECIAL: My Scary Supernatural Experiences
summary: Halloween storytelling with no training content. NH tells of a childhood Caribbean trip around age 10 where he nearly drowned and was surrounded by sharks on a reef, then spent the holiday with a mysterious older girl nobody else remembers, and a second story about exploring an abandoned children's camp with ritual-like signs, a masked man and a severed animal head.
claims: He was supposed to stay at a Thai hotel hit by the 2004 tsunami but the trip was delayed by a week
He has a conflicted relationship with water: nearly drowned at two, nearly swept out by a riptide in Miami a year ago; his name means friend of the sea in some language
Around age 10 he was left behind while snorkeling in the Caribbean, blocked by jellyfish, climbed onto a shark-filled reef bleeding, and was rescued by a guide before passing out
As a kid he was a pudgy, insecure boy while an older teen in the group had a six-pack
He describes a blonde older girl he spent the holiday with whom his mother says never existed and who is absent from all trip photos

He explored an abandoned kids' camp with 13 hoops each 13 feet tall in a pentacle-like pattern, fled a masked man in white, and on a night return found a severed horned animal head in the pool; the camp had closed after abuse reports and a child's death
He is exactly six feet tall, the same as the depth of the pool he nearly drowned in at two
